tools.name: grant-compliance_requirements-extract
tools.description: Read Requirement lines and structured requirements. Other prose is not turned into a grant rule. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/grant-compliance/requirements-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: grant-compliance_eligibility-check
tools.description: Compare each supplied rule with the supplied fact of the same name. A match is not an approval, and missing facts are not filled in. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/grant-compliance/eligibility-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: grant-compliance_application-completeness
tools.description: Mark a requirement present only when an application section cites its id. The answer is not scored, and a complete set is not compliance. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/grant-compliance/application-completeness. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: grant-compliance_budget-validate
tools.description: Sum the supplied lines, compare that sum with a supplied total, and check supplied category amount or percent caps. No cap is assumed. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/grant-compliance/budget-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: grant-compliance_expense-eligibility-check
tools.description: Apply only the supplied category decisions. A category with no rule stays not supplied, and an eligible rule is not a funder decision. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/grant-compliance/expense-eligibility-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: grant-compliance_evidence-match
tools.description: Attach evidence that cites a requirement id. Evidence with no id is not matched, and the strength of the evidence is not judged. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/grant-compliance/evidence-match. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: grant-compliance_deliverable-track
tools.description: Repeat the status supplied for each deliverable and compare an update date with a supplied due date. accepted_by_caller is not an official acceptance. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/grant-compliance/deliverable-track. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: grant-compliance_report-validate
tools.description: Mark a reporting obligation present only when the report cites its id. A present section is not accepted by a funder. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/grant-compliance/report-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: grant-compliance_deadline-extract
tools.description: Read Deadline lines that contain a YYYY-MM-DD date. Other dates in the guidelines are not turned into deadlines. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/grant-compliance/deadline-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: grant-compliance_report
tools.description: Combine the supplied requirement, eligibility, budget, evidence, deliverable, and reporting checks. The report does not approve the application or determine compliance. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/grant-compliance/report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "grant-compliance" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: grant-compliance_requirements-extract, grant-compliance_eligibility-check, grant-compliance_budget-validate, grant-compliance_expense-eligibility-check, grant-compliance_deadline-extract · Public sink: grant-compliance_requirements-extract, grant-compliance_eligibility-check, grant-compliance_application-completeness, grant-compliance_budget-validate, grant-compliance_expense-eligibility-check, grant-compliance_evidence-match, grant-compliance_deliverable-track, grant-compliance_report-validate, grant-compliance_deadline-extract, grant-compliance_report · Destructive: grant-compliance_requirements-extract, grant-compliance_eligibility-check, grant-compliance_application-completeness, grant-compliance_budget-validate, grant-compliance_expense-eligibility-check, grant-compliance_evidence-match, grant-compliance_deliverable-track, grant-compliance_report-validate, grant-compliance_deadline-extract, grant-compliance_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: grant-compliance_requirements-extract, grant-compliance_eligibility-check, grant-compliance_budget-validate, grant-compliance_expense-eligibility-check, grant-compliance_deadline-extract · Public sink: grant-compliance_requirements-extract, grant-compliance_eligibility-check, grant-compliance_application-completeness, grant-compliance_budget-validate, grant-compliance_expense-eligibility-check, grant-compliance_evidence-match, grant-compliance_deliverable-track, grant-compliance_report-validate, grant-compliance_deadline-extract, grant-compliance_report · Destructive: grant-compliance_requirements-extract, grant-compliance_eligibility-check, grant-compliance_application-completeness, grant-compliance_budget-validate, grant-compliance_expense-eligibility-check, grant-compliance_evidence-match, grant-compliance_deliverable-track, grant-compliance_report-validate, grant-compliance_deadline-extract, grant-compliance_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
